✓ 13. Shared legality 拒絕左投 C／2B／3B／SS starter assignment

✓ 19. Invitation reload 不改 roster／need／competition／role／interest
✓ 20. Selection 鎖定同一 school-year roster identity

✓ 26. Opportunity 使用 selected roster-derived need／competition
✓ 27. Match-specific identity 只影響對手，不重抽玩家學校 roster
✓ 27a. Match reload 保留 selected school-year identity 與 roster actors
✓ 28. 左投 Invitation recruiting profile 不再評估 C／2B／3B／SS
